questions.explain_zh: You don't need an appointment… just come in before four。jab 是英式口語的「打針」。

questions.question: What is a normal reaction?
options: An aching arm for a day or two
questions.explain_zh: Your arm might ache for a day or two；feel a bit off 是「有點不舒服」。

questions.question: Who should wait?
options: People who had a fever this week
People who had it last year
questions.explain_zh: If you've had a fever this week, wait until you're over it。be over it 是「好了、康復了」。

title: Sick note for work
transcript: For the first week you can self-certify, so you just tell your employer yourself. After seven days you need a note from us, and there's no charge for that one. If your employer wants a letter for anything else, that's a private letter and there is a fee.

questions.question: What can you do for the first week?
options: Nothing, you need a note immediately
Send an email to the clinic
questions.explain_zh: self-certify 是「自己申報」，不必先拿到醫師的證明。

questions.question: When do you need a note from the clinic?
options: Only if you are in hospital
questions.explain_zh: After seven days you need a note from us —— 第七天之後才需要診所開證明，前七天自己申報就好。

questions.question: Which letter costs money?
options: The sick note after seven days
A private letter for something else
questions.explain_zh: that's a private letter and there is a fee；七天後的病假證明是 no charge（免費）。

title: Repeat prescription online
transcript: You can order the repeat online, but leave three working days because it goes to the doctor first and then to the pharmacy. The one you're on now needs a review in April, so after that they won't renew it until you've been in. Order the inhaler separately, that one isn't on the repeat list.

questions.question: How long should you allow for a repeat prescription?
questions.explain_zh: leave three working days —— leave 在這裡是「預留時間」。

questions.question: What happens after April?
options: They won't renew it until you've been in
You can order more at once
questions.explain_zh: needs a review in April… won't renew it until you've been in。been in 是「進來看過診」。

questions.question: What is special about the inhaler?
questions.explain_zh: 這一項不在 repeat list（可重複領藥的清單）上，要另外下單，不會跟著其他藥一起來。

title: Essay deadline extended
transcript: Quick announcement about the essay. The deadline has moved from Friday to the following Wednesday at midday, because the reading list went up late. The word count is the same, two thousand words, and the late penalty is still five percent a day after the new deadline.

questions.question: What is the new deadline?
questions.explain_zh: moved from Friday to the following Wednesday at midday。midday 是中午十二點，不是午夜。

questions.question: Why was it moved?
options: The reading list went up late
questions.explain_zh: because the reading list went up late。go up 在這裡是「被公布、上架」。

questions.question: What has not changed?
options: The word count and the late penalty
questions.explain_zh: The word count is the same… the late penalty is still five percent a day，兩件事都沒變。

title: Library books on short loan
transcript: The ones with the red sticker are short loan, so it's three days rather than three weeks, and they can't be renewed if someone else has requested them. You can read them in the library as long as you like though. Fines are ten cents a day, but they only start after a week.

questions.question: How long can you keep a red sticker book?
questions.explain_zh: short loan, so it's three days rather than three weeks。short loan 是「短期借閱」。

questions.question: When can't you renew a book?
options: If someone else has requested it
If it has a red sticker
questions.explain_zh: can't be renewed if someone else has requested them。renew 是「續借」。

questions.question: When do fines start?
questions.explain_zh: they only start after a week —— 逾期第一週不罰，之後每天十分。

title: Office hours moved online
transcript: My office hours are Tuesday two to four, but this week they're online because I'm at a conference. The link is on the course page, and you don't need to book, just join and wait. If nobody's there in the first ten minutes I'll leave, so come early rather than late.

questions.question: When are the office hours?
questions.explain_zh: My office hours are Tuesday two to four。office hours 是老師的「開放諮詢時間」。

questions.question: Why are they online this week?
options: The lecturer is at a conference
questions.explain_zh: because I'm at a conference，人在外面開會。

questions.question: What should you do to attend?
options: Just join the link and wait
questions.explain_zh: you don't need to book, just join and wait，而且要早點到（come early rather than late）。

title: Referencing style for the report
transcript: Use the author and date in the text, not footnotes, and put the full details in one list at the end. Page numbers are only needed when you quote directly. If you can't find a date, put no date in brackets rather than guessing the year, and don't leave it blank.

questions.question: How should sources appear in the text?
options: Only at the end of the report
questions.explain_zh: Use the author and date in the text, not footnotes —— 內文用作者與年份，不用腳註。

questions.question: When do you need page numbers?
questions.explain_zh: only needed when you quote directly。quote directly 是「直接引用原文」。

questions.question: What should you do if a source has no date?
questions.explain_zh: put no date in brackets rather than guessing —— 寧可標明「無日期」也不要猜。

title: Feedback on the first draft
transcript: The argument is there, but it arrives too late. You spend a page and a half summarising other people before you say what you think. Cut most of that, put your position in the first paragraph, and use the space you save to deal with the counterargument, which at the moment you only mention in one line.

questions.question: What is the main problem with the draft?
options: There is no argument at all
questions.explain_zh: The argument is there, but it arrives too late —— 有論點，但出現得太晚。

questions.question: What should be in the first paragraph?
questions.explain_zh: put your position in the first paragraph。position 是「你的立場」。

questions.question: What needs more space?
questions.explain_zh: use the space you save to deal with the counterargument（反面論點），現在只寫了一行。

title: Choosing between two electives
transcript: They're both on Thursday, so you can only take one. The statistics one is assessed by two tests, and the media one is one long essay plus a presentation. If you hate presenting, that decides it. Places are given out on Monday and the statistics one usually goes first.

questions.question: Why can you only take one?
questions.explain_zh: They're both on Thursday，時間衝堂。

questions.question: How is the media course assessed?
options: One long essay plus a presentation
questions.explain_zh: the media one is one long essay plus a presentation。assess 是「評分、評量」。

questions.question: Which course fills up faster?
options: They fill at the same rate
questions.explain_zh: the statistics one usually goes first。go first 在這裡是「先被選滿」。

title: Group project split three ways
transcript: So there are three of us and three parts, and I'd rather we each take one and swap for proofreading at the end. I can do the data section because I've got the software already. Whoever does the introduction should write it last, honestly, it's much easier once the rest exists.

questions.question: How does the speaker want to divide the work?
options: One part each, then proofread each other's
questions.explain_zh: we each take one and swap for proofreading at the end。swap 是「互換」。

questions.question: Which part does the speaker want?
questions.explain_zh: 他說 I can do the data section，因為軟體他已經有了（I've got the software already）。

questions.question: What is the advice about the introduction?
options: Let the lecturer see it early
questions.explain_zh: should write it last… much easier once the rest exists —— 其他部分寫好了再寫前言比較好寫。

title: Exam is open book
transcript: It's open book, which people always think means easy, and it doesn't. You can bring the textbook and your own notes on paper, but no laptops and nothing shared during the exam. There are four questions and you answer three, and they're all worth the same.

questions.question: What can you bring?
questions.explain_zh: 可以帶 the textbook 與紙本筆記，但明確說了 no laptops —— 筆電不行。

questions.question: How many questions do you answer?
questions.explain_zh: four questions and you answer three —— 四題選三題作答。

questions.question: What does the lecturer say about open book exams?
options: People wrongly assume they are easy
questions.explain_zh: people always think means easy, and it doesn't —— 老師刻意提醒這個誤解。

title: Enrolling in the evening class
transcript: The Tuesday evening class runs for ten weeks and there are four places left. It's sixty dollars, or forty if you're a student, and you pay at the first session rather than now. Bring something to write with, everything else is provided.

questions.question: How long is the course?
questions.explain_zh: runs for ten weeks。run 在課程的語境是「持續、開課」。

questions.question: How much does a student pay?
questions.explain_zh: sixty dollars, or forty if you're a student，學生價是四十。

questions.question: When do you pay?
options: At the end of the course
questions.explain_zh: 第一堂課才付（at the first session），現在不用先繳。

title: Lab safety before you start
transcript: Two things before anyone touches anything. Goggles stay on the whole time, not pushed up on your head, and long hair gets tied back. If you spill something, don't wipe it up yourself, tell me and step away. The nearest eyewash station is by the door you came in through.

questions.question: What is the rule about goggles?
options: Wear them only when heating things
Keep them on the whole time
questions.explain_zh: 護目鏡全程都要戴著，而且不能推到頭上（not pushed up on your head）。

questions.question: What should you do if you spill something?
options: Tell the teacher and step away
questions.explain_zh: don't wipe it up yourself, tell me and step away。step away 是「退開」。

questions.question: Where is the eyewash station?
options: By the door you came in through
At the front of the room
questions.explain_zh: by the door you came in through —— 就在你們進來的那個門邊。

title: Two rounds and a task
transcript: So the process is two conversations and a short task. The first one is thirty minutes with me, mostly about your background. Then there's a take home task, about two hours of work, and finally a longer chat with the team. We aim to get back to people within a week at each stage.

questions.question: How long is the first conversation?
questions.explain_zh: 第一關是 thirty minutes with me，三十分鐘，主要問經歷。

questions.question: What is the task like?
options: A written test in the office
About two hours of work at home
questions.explain_zh: take home task 是「帶回家做的作業」，這裡說大約要花兩小時。

questions.question: How quickly do they reply?
questions.explain_zh: within a week at each stage —— 每一關都盡量一週內回覆。

title: Salary range for the role
transcript: The range for this level is fifty to sixty, and where you land in it depends on experience rather than negotiation, so I'd rather be straight about that. There's a review after six months, and the bonus is company wide, usually about one month's salary but it isn't guaranteed.

questions.question: What decides where you sit in the range?
questions.explain_zh: depends on experience rather than negotiation —— 看經歷，不是看談判。

questions.question: When is the first review?
questions.explain_zh: There's a review after six months。review 在這裡是「薪資或表現的檢視」。

questions.question: What does she say about the bonus?
options: It is about one month's salary but not guaranteed
questions.explain_zh: usually about one month's salary but it isn't guaranteed，不保證一定發。

title: Why did you leave that job
transcript: I left because the team was restructured and my role moved away from the work I wanted to do. I stayed for four months after the change to hand things over properly, and I'd do that again. What I'm looking for now is somewhere the same person owns a problem from start to finish.

questions.question: Why did the candidate leave?
options: The role moved away from the work he wanted
questions.explain_zh: my role moved away from the work I wanted to do —— 職務內容跟他想做的事越來越遠。

questions.question: What did he do after the change?
options: Stayed four months to hand over
questions.explain_zh: stayed for four months… to hand things over properly。hand over 是「交接」。

questions.question: What is he looking for now?
options: Owning a problem from start to finish
questions.explain_zh: the same person owns a problem from start to finish —— 想要能從頭負責到尾的工作方式。

title: Tell me about a mistake
transcript: I shipped a change on a Friday afternoon without telling support, and they spent Monday morning answering questions they had no answers to. Nothing broke, but that was luck. Now I write the support note before I write the code, and if I can't explain the change in three lines it usually means I don't understand it yet.

questions.question: What was the mistake?
options: He shipped without telling the support team
questions.explain_zh: shipped a change… without telling support。ship 在工作語境是「把東西上線、發布」。

questions.question: What was the consequence?
questions.explain_zh: answering questions they had no answers to —— 客服被問了卻答不出來。

questions.question: What does he do differently now?
options: He writes the support note before the code
questions.explain_zh: I write the support note before I write the code，順序反過來，而且用三行講不清楚就代表自己還沒懂。

title: Notice period and start date
transcript: My notice is one month, and I've got about a week of holiday left that I'd rather take than be paid for. So realistically I could start five weeks from an offer. If that's too late for you, I can ask about leaving earlier, but I'd rather not leave them in a mess.

questions.question: How long is the notice period?
questions.explain_zh: My notice is one month。notice (period) 是「離職預告期」。

questions.question: How soon could he start?
questions.explain_zh: 一個月預告加上一週假，所以 five weeks from an offer。

questions.question: What is his attitude to leaving earlier?
options: He will ask, but doesn't want to leave a mess
He wants to be paid for the holiday instead
questions.explain_zh: I can ask… but I'd rather not leave them in a mess，願意問但不想把爛攤子丟給前公司。

title: Question about the team
transcript: You asked what a normal week looks like. There's a planning session on Monday, one demo on Thursday, and the rest is fairly unstructured. Two people are remote in another time zone, so we keep the shared meetings before three. Most decisions get written down rather than settled in a room.

questions.question: What happens on Thursday?
questions.explain_zh: one demo on Thursday；planning 是週一。

questions.question: Why are shared meetings before three?
options: Two people are in another time zone
questions.explain_zh: Two people are remote in another time zone —— 為了配合時差。

questions.question: How are most decisions made?
questions.explain_zh: written down rather than settled in a room，多半用文字記錄而不是開會拍板。

title: Reference check call
transcript: We'd need two references, one of them a line manager, and we only contact them after you've accepted, not before. If your current employer doesn't know you're looking, that's completely normal and we won't approach them until you say so. The checks usually take three or four days.

questions.question: How many references are needed?
questions.explain_zh: two references, one of them a line manager。line manager 是「直屬主管」。

questions.question: When are references contacted?
options: Only if there is a problem
questions.explain_zh: only contact them after you've accepted, not before —— 接受了才會聯絡。

questions.question: What if your current employer doesn't know?
options: That is normal and they will wait for you
You must tell them that week
questions.explain_zh: that's completely normal and we won't approach them until you say so，會等你同意。

title: Presentation for the final round
transcript: For the last stage we'd like a fifteen minute presentation, then fifteen minutes of questions. Pick any project you've worked on, it doesn't have to be a success, and slides are optional. Four of us will be there and two will join from home. Send anything you want on screen the day before.

questions.question: How long should the presentation be?
questions.explain_zh: a fifteen minute presentation, then fifteen minutes of questions，簡報十五分鐘、問答十五分鐘。

questions.question: What can the project be?
questions.explain_zh: it doesn't have to be a success —— 不成功的專案也可以講。

questions.question: What should you send the day before?
questions.explain_zh: Send anything you want on screen the day before，要投影的東西前一天先寄。
